title: When God lifts you, it won’t matter who tried to hold you down—His elevation breaks every limit.
paragraphs:
When God lifts you, it won’t matter who tried to hold you down—His elevation breaks every limit.
You’re rising because Heaven said so. 🔥🙌

📖 Bible Verse:
Psalm 75:7 (NIV) — “It is God who judges: He brings one down, He exalts another.”
